ourWork.seoTitle: Our Work | Community Support & Education | AEINY
ourWork.seoDescription: Explore how AEINY supports immigrant communities through human rights, education, cultural heritage and community wellbeing.
ourWork.heroDescription: AEINY brings together community support, education, cultural heritage and initiatives for wellbeing to help immigrant communities navigate challenges and build opportunities.
ourWork.heroPhotoAlt: Community members gather together at an AEINY event.

osha.title: OSHA and Construction Training
osha.lead: Practical learning for safer work and greater independence.
osha.copy: Centro Comunitario Andino, part of Alianza Ecuatoriana Internacional, promotes construction safety education, including OSHA training. Explore our courses and contact us for information on upcoming classes.
osha.photoAlt: Participants attend a workforce training class.

migrants.title: Migrant Support and Guidance
migrants.lead: Information and community connections to help people navigate life in New York.
migrants.copy: Centro Comunitario Andino supports immigrants, workers and families with information on migration, labor rights and community resources. Its work promotes awareness of rights and connections to support within the community.

points.rights: Awareness of immigrant and labor rights

migrants.photoAlt: Community outreach at an AEINY activity.

aid.title: Humanitarian Aid and Family Support
aid.lead: Turning community solidarity into practical help.
aid.copy: Alianza Ecuatoriana Internacional carries out initiatives to support families, including food distributions through Centro Comunitario Andino. Discover these efforts through their stories, photographs and videos.
aid.photoAlt: Participants beside food prepared for the community aid initiative on November 18, 2025.

ourWork.finalTitle: Looking for information or a way to contribute?
ourWork.finalCopy: Connect with AEINY to learn more about its community initiatives and opportunities for participation.
